claims.value: Source-explicit SM/MSSM inheritance is expanded using the declared atlas baseline: three ordinary SM chiral families, no independent RH neutrino unless stated. Exact Dynkin and all-LH conversion are conventions/derivations, not newly printed source tables. Gauge connections and dependent conjugates are not extra matter.
UV hypercolour SU4 has five LH antisymmetric6 fermions psi and colour3 chi in HC4 plus colour anti3 chitilde in antiHC4. Global SU5/SU3 flavour factors are not all gauged. SU4 6 Dynkin [0,1,0].

Gauge SM colour as diagonal global colour and Y=T3R+X. Psi five decomposes into weak2_(+1/2)+2_(-1/2)+1_0; chi/chitilde weak singlets have Y=-1/3,+1/3. Colour triplet dimensionality is a gauge irrep, not three copies. Ordinary SM fermions are external; Higgs and other Goldstones are composites, not elementary UV scalars.

limitations: Completeness is for the displayed microscopic HC-plus-elementary-SM-fermion EFT regime, not unknown mediators above its four-fermion cutoff. No elementary Higgs added to a composite-Higgs UV inventory.
